tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: ye shes rab 'bar las: tshe dbang 'chi med rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

ye shes rab 'bar las: tshe dbang 'chi med rnga sgra ni: dha dhi ghu ti hūm̐: 'chi med he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: ye shes rab 'bar drag po'i rnal 'byor pas: rang gzhan tshe yi bar chad zhi ba dang: tshe yi rig 'dzin mchog la dbang ba'i thabs: 'chi med rnga sgra tshe bcud nor bu 'di: lang gro'i sprul par bka' babs rjes gnang nas: smon lam mthu btsan dus su spyod pa 'byung: ri ngogs drang srong 'du ba'i sa phyogs su: dkyil 'khor bum pa tshe yi ril bur bcas: rtags tshad grub pa'i mtshan ma rdzogs par bsgrub: 'grub nas snod ldan bcud dang sbyar ba'i thabs: khrus byas bgegs bskrad maṇ+ḍal gsol ba ni: e ma mgon po che ba'i mchog: rig 'dzin tshe yi dbang phyug dgongs: dus min 'chi ba'i gegs sel nas: tshe yi rig 'dzin dngos grub stsol: zhus pas: ho dad ldan dge ba'i ngang tshul can: 'gro la byams dang phan sems ldan: dge ba'i sa bon ldan la sbyin: tshul min yin na phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: yang zhu ba ni: bdag ni dkar po'i chos la zhugs: gzhan la phan pa'i sems mchog bskyed: dus min 'chi ba bzlog pa dang: tshe yi dbang mchog bstsal du gsol: zhus pas: ye shes pa dbab: dam tshig pa brtan par byed: hūm̐ hrī: ye shes rab 'bar dkyil 'khor lha: drag po'i lha dbang lus la bskur: 'jigs pa brgyad sogs dus min bgegs: tshe la bar chad mi 'byung shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: artsig sogs= kā ya a bhi ṣiñca ā+oṃ: hūm̐ hrī: skye med bum pa'i klong yangs nas: chos nyid 'dus ma byas pa'i lha: tshe mchog 'chi med bdud rtsi 'dis: tshe yi rig 'dzin mchog thob shog: oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan ti ye swā hā: tshe bh+rūm̐ g.yu bh+rūm̐ g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐: ā yur+dz+nyā na g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐: kā ya a bhi ṣiñca ā+oṃ: bhan+dha mgrin par bzhag: hūm̐ hrī: bhan+dha drag po'i gzhal yas khang: lha tshogs byang chub sems kyi rgyun: myang bas 'chi med rig 'dzin gyi:

dngos grub bdud rtsi'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags dang*/ wā ka a bhi ṣiñca ā: shel dang rdo rje snying khar bzhag: hūm̐ hrī: sems nyid gsal la 'gag pa med: snang stong zung 'jug skye 'chi bral: mi shigs rdo rje drag po'i rgya: skye 'chi bral ba'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags dang*/ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sgrub gtor spyi bor bzhag la: hūm̐ hrī: dam tshig drag po srung ba'i gur: ye shes 'chi med bcud du dbab: dbang drag tshe dpag med mgon gyi: yon tan lhun rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ artsig= ā+oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti ye swā hā: gu ṇa ā yur+dz+nyā na tiṣ+ṭha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: tshe ril chang bcas pa sbyin la: hūm̐ hrī: chos sku snang mtha' longs sku tshe dpag med: sprul sku pad 'byung sngon byung drang srong gi: tshe ril bdud rtsi zag med rdzas mchog gis: reg tshad bgegs zhi myang tshad rig 'dzin sar: skad cig bgrod pa'i phrin las rdzas mchog gis: mkha' khyab sems can sgrol ba'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags: sarba karma ā yur+dz+nyā na tiṣ+ṭha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ hrī: dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya ma chung: gsang sngags dbang gi srog shing dam tshig srungs: yar mchod mar sbyin dge ba'i so nam dang: gzhan gyi srog bslu tshā tsha lam 'phrang bcos: dbang rten yan lag gces so rjes 'jug rnams: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes gnam chen brag dkar zla gam dbang gi dkyil 'khor gyi gnas bcud/ dus su chos bdag la babs pa 'di'o// //
